items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: call Chuck, have him come in, you go to the hospital.

ctx.x: So a typical day at Twentieth Century Fox, you’re talking working days now instead of late nights.

Yes. Oh some nights, not late nights. For instance if you do a picture, let’s say they call you in at nine, so you’d work from nine to twelve, go out and have lunch, come back at let’s say two, two to five. That usually, that’s about it. Sometimes you’d have to finish a picture, and you’d come back at seven. Everybody got loaded and nobody could see the music but it was okay and we had some fun at night. But that was occasionally. Most of the time during the day, well we had at least five clarinets and we had two…
What came out by the way?
